display.purpose: One section headline per band: a short declarative sentence, balanced, held to 16ch.

title.purpose: The lede under each headline, in the muted text color of the ground.

body-sm.purpose: Notes, captions, nav links, table text, card copy.

button.purpose: Pill actions and the skip link.

code.purpose: MQL listings, terminal output, file paths, legend terms. Ligatures off, tabular figures for inline code and numbers.

label.purpose: File-name captions and mock window titles; table headers step up to weight 500.

shadows.name: paper-lift
shadows.purpose: White figures and lockup tiles on paper. Never on plum.

shadows.name: paper-rest
shadows.purpose: White cards that sit flatter on paper, such as the misuse cards.

motion.name: print
motion.value: print 1.25s steps(14, end) .15s both; clip-path inset(0 0 100% 0) to inset(0 0 0 0)
motion.purpose: The one authored motion: the mark's lanes reveal top to bottom like lines of git log --graph. Only under prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.

motion.name: commit
motion.value: commit .5s cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1) both; scale(.2) and opacity 0 to scale(1) and opacity 1; delays .45s branch, .7s merge, .95s commit
motion.purpose: Vertex rings arrive after the print passes. Same reduced-motion guard.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Every hover and active state change. Nothing else is animated.

breakpoints.name: stack
breakpoints.purpose: Splits collapse to one column; the large mark moves above the copy and its rails are cut to frame; lockup tiles and don't cards go two-up.

breakpoints.name: phone
breakpoints.purpose: Body drops to 16px; don't cards go single-column; swatches go from four to two columns.

laneGrid.line: 1px; plum-line on plum, paper-line on paper
laneGrid.registration: Line 0 is the wrap's left edge and line 12 its right edge; lines continue at the same pitch to the band edges. Layout grids use the 12 lanes with no column gap.

mark.source: brand/build_logo.py generates every file in brand/logo/; never edit the SVGs by hand

favicon.tile: 64 plum square, rx 14, mark at 0.8 scale

mark.clearSpace: one lane, 18 units, on every side
mark.lockup: mark at 1.6x, offset y 8.8, rails from ascender 20 to baseline 100; wordmark at x 122
mark.wordmark: lowercase manjodb, monoline stroke 9, round caps and joins; x-height 50 to 100, ascender 20, descender 125; bowls r 25, m arches r 16, n arch r 20; the j dot is a commit ring, r 6, stroke 5.5

variants.mono: currentColor throughout; inline the SVG so the color inherits

components.name: The Mark, printing in
components.description: Reverse mark on plum with the one authored motion: a stepped top-to-bottom print, then the commit rings.
components.css: .ds-plum { background: var(--plum, #2B0D3F); padding: 32px; } .ds-mark-wrap { display: grid; place-items: center; } .ds-mark { display: block; height: 160px; width: auto; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) { .ds-print { animation: ds-print 1.25s steps(14, end) .15s both; } .ds-commit { transform-box: fill-box; transform-origin: center; animation: ds-commit .5s cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1) both; } .ds-c1 { animation-delay: .45s; } .ds-c2 { animation-delay: .95s; } .ds-c3 { animation-delay: .7s; } @keyframes ds-print { from { clip-path: inset(0 0 100% 0); } to { clip-path: inset(0 0 0 0); } } @keyframes ds-commit { from { transform: scale(.2); opacity: 0; } to { transform: scale(1); opacity: 1; } } }

narrative.overview:
ManjoDB is drawn in the graph notation developers already read every day: the lanes of `git log --graph`. Two rails, one branch, a commit and a merge make an M, and the same notation draws every diagram the product will ever show. The system refuses the category default, a node-network hexagon in a purple gradient. It reads as precise and engineering-serious: a small number of materials, used with discipline.

The world is built from full-width bands of ground, deep plum or lilac-tinted paper, each carrying a faint vertical lane grid registered to the content wrap. On those grounds everything is achromatic except the edges. Lanes and relationships carry the only color (pink for the relationship, lilac or violet for structure); vertices, headlines, body copy and grounds stay plum, ink, vertex white or paper. Every stroke is monoline with round caps, from the mark to the wordmark to the diagram lanes.

Density is calm and editorial: generous band padding, short headlines held to 16 characters a line, ledes held to 62 characters, and mono type reserved for anything a machine reads. There is one authored motion: the mark prints itself row by row, the way a graph log scrolls into a terminal, and then holds still.
keyCharacteristics: Color lives only on edges, plus one pink active state; vertices and type stay achromatic.
Full-width plum and paper bands; a band never changes ground partway through.
A 12-column lane grid, registered to the 1240px wrap, on every band.
Lexend for people, JetBrains Mono for machines.
A drawn monoline wordmark, never typeset.

rules.name: The Edges Only Rule
rules.body: Color marks an edge and nothing else: a lane, a relationship path, a relationship name in query text, a graph edge in terminal output. Vertices, headlines, body text and grounds are always achromatic. The one sanctioned extension is the active state: Lane Pink fills the primary action and draws focus, selection and download links, because an action is the path you take next.

rules.name: The Two Inks Rule
rules.body: Every lane color comes as a pair: bright on plum (Lane Pink, Lane Lilac), deep on paper and white (Lane Pink Deep, Lane Violet Deep), so every edge holds at least 4.5:1 against its ground. Never put the bright pair on paper or the deep pair on plum.

rules.name: The Never Alone Rule
rules.body: Color never carries meaning by itself. Every colored edge in a diagram is also named or numbered (edge IDs 81 and 84, the label `OWNS`), and every legend key pairs its swatch with a word.

rules.name: The Drawn Name Rule
rules.body: The name is never typeset. Wherever "manjodb" appears as a brand (top bar, hero, footer, docs header) it is a wordmark or lockup file; the page's h1 is the wordmark image with alt text "ManjoDB". In running prose, the product is written "ManjoDB".

rules.name: The Mono Means Machine Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono is for what a machine reads or writes: queries, commands, paths, IDs, table cells, diagram vertex and edge labels. Everything a person reads is Lexend.

rules.name: The Registered Lanes Rule
rules.body: Nothing floats off the grid. Every band shows the lane grid, the content wrap spans lines 0 to 12, and splits, file rows and the large mark's rails start on lane lines; card grids fill the wrap with a 16px gap.

rules.name: The Plum Is Flat Rule
rules.body: No shadow ever falls on plum. Depth there is a darker plum, not a shadow.

dos: Do reserve color for edges: lanes, relationship paths, relationship names in queries, and the single pink active state.
Do switch lane inks with the ground: #FF4FA0 and #B98CFF on plum, #D81B73 and #6E3AD9 on white or paper.
Do keep vertices open rings in Ink or Vertex White, knocking a gap out of the lanes beneath them; only the favicon uses solid vertices.
Do register every layout to the 12-lane grid on the 1240px wrap, and show the grid on every band.
Do use the generated files from `brand/build_logo.py`, and change geometry only in that script.
Do give the mark one lane (18 units) of clear space, keep it at 24px tall or larger, and switch to the favicon below 24px.
Do draw every diagram from a real query and its result, labeled as synthetic when the data is.
Do name or number every colored edge so meaning never depends on color alone.
donts: Don't color a vertex. Color belongs to edges only.
Don't add a gradient. Lanes are flat, one color each.
Don't rotate the mark. Lanes run vertically; history reads top to bottom.
Don't retype the wordmark in a font. Use the drawn files.
Don't put a shadow on plum; recess with Plum Deep instead.
Don't add a second authored motion, or play the print-in for visitors who prefer reduced motion.
Don't set headlines, body text or a band ground in a lane color.
Don't reach for a node-network hexagon or a purple gradient; that is the category default this identity refuses.
